messages:
Priya (PM): dropping a quick sync 7 figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/onboard-compact7
Priya (PM): decision needed: compact start strip (small pill) vs full-width banner for first-run quickstarts. tradeoff: subtle vs discoverable. want copy + a11y checks.

Elaine (Designer): compact strip is less intrusive and works with persistent header, but banner supports thumbnails + short descriptions. strip could expand into a tray.

Ravi (UX Research): past intercepts show users prefer low-friction CTAs; however, a short descriptive line + "~5 min" boosts confidence and clicks. suggest test both.

Mike (Frontend): both are doable. tray needs persisted state and animation; banner needs responsive height handling. will ensure focus management.

Sofia (Accessibility): notes: ensure color contrast for small text, aria-expanded on tray, role=region + aria-label on banner, and keyboard focus return after close. avoid trapping focus.

Sam (Devex): analytics: onboard_variant (strip|banner), shown, clicked_open, clicked_skip, dismissed. will add experiment id.

onboard-bot: please run axe smoke and keyboard nav before merging.

Priya (PM): action list: Elaine update copy variations (friendly vs directive), include "5 min" microcopy; Sofia review tokens; Mike open draft PR with DOM order fix; Sam add events and flag. target: Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

Elaine (Designer): on it 1 will post updated frames tomorrow with contrast numbers and two copy tones.

Priya (PM): great, thanks everyone. we'll A/B after internal canary.
